# toll-booth

> L402 payment middleware for Rust. Gates any HTTP API behind Lightning payments.

toll-booth is a Rust crate that adds HTTP 402 payment gating to any API. It uses the L402 protocol (macaroons + Lightning invoices) to challenge unauthenticated requests, verify payments via preimage, and manage credit balances. Designed as a Tower Layer, it drops straight into axum.

## Key features

- Credit-balance model: one Lightning payment funds multiple requests, with automatic debit per call
- Bring-your-own backend: implement `LightningBackend` for any Lightning node (a Phoenixd backend is planned, not yet implemented)
- Bring-your-own storage: implement `StorageBackend` for any store (`MemoryStorage` included; a SQLite backend is planned, not yet implemented)
- Pluggable payment rails: `PaymentRail` trait supports per-request, credit, and session modes
- Free tier: configurable free requests or free credits per IP per day (IPs hashed with daily salt)
- Tiered pricing: per-route pricing with tier keys sent via `X-Toll-Tier` header
- Cost reconciliation: adjust credit balances after upstream responds with actual cost
- Custom macaroon caveats: arbitrary `key = value` pairs minted with `toll_booth::macaroon::mint_macaroon` and forwarded as `X-Toll-Caveat-<Key>` headers. `route`, `expires` and `ip` caveats are enforced on verification, but this crate cannot mint them
- axum middleware via `TollBoothLayer` (Tower Layer/Service)

## Architecture

```
Request -> TollBoothLayer -> TollBoothEngine
                                |
                                +-- Pricing table lookup
                                +-- Payment rails (L402Rail, extensible)
                                +-- Free tier fallback
                                +-- StorageBackend (credit/debit/settle)
                                +-- LightningBackend (invoice creation)
                                |
                            TollBoothResult:
                              Proxy     -> forward to the wrapped axum service
                              Challenge -> 402 + WWW-Authenticate
                              Pass      -> unpriced route, forward
                              Blocked   -> 500 (payment infrastructure failure)
```

## Quick start

```sh
cargo add toll-booth axum@0.8
cargo add tokio --features macros,rt-multi-thread,net
```

or in `Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[dependencies]
toll-booth = { version = "0.2", features = ["l402", "axum-middleware"] }
axum = "0.8"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "rt-multi-thread", "net"] }
```

`async-trait = "0.1"` is also needed to implement `LightningBackend`, and `ipnet = "2"` to configure trusted proxies.

```rust
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;
use toll_booth::{
    L402Rail, L402RailConfig, MemoryStorage, PricingEntry, RootKey, StorageBackend,
    TollBoothConfig, TollBoothEngine, TollBoothLayer,
};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let storage: Arc<dyn StorageBackend> = Arc::new(MemoryStorage::new());

    // 64 hex characters (32 bytes). Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32
    let root_key = RootKey::from_hex(&std::env::var("L402_ROOT_KEY").expect("L402_ROOT_KEY not set"))
        .expect("L402_ROOT_KEY must be 64 hex characters");

    let l402 = L402Rail::new(L402RailConfig {
        root_key,
        storage: storage.clone(),
        default_amount: 100, // sats; invoice amount when the matched price has no `sats`
        // DEVELOPMENT ONLY: no invoice, random payment_hash, so no client can pay. Do not deploy.
        backend: None,
        service_name: Some("My API".to_string()),
    });

    let mut pricing = std::collections::HashMap::new();
    pricing.insert("/v1/chat".to_string(), PricingEntry::Simple(100));

    let engine = TollBoothEngine::new(TollBoothConfig {
        storage,
        pricing,
        rails: vec![Box::new(l402)],
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .unwrap();

    let app = axum::Router::new()
        .route("/v1/chat", axum::routing::post(|| async { "hello" }))
        .layer(TollBoothLayer::new(engine));

    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("0.0.0.0:3000").await.unwrap();
    // ConnectInfo supplies the client IP; without it the IP is "unknown" and the free tier is never granted.
    axum::serve(listener, app.into_make_service_with_connect_info::<SocketAddr>())
        .await
        .unwrap();
}
```

Notes:

- `L402_ROOT_KEY` is exactly 64 hex characters. `RootKey::from_hex(&str) -> Result<RootKey, MacaroonError>` fails with `MacaroonError::InvalidRootKey` otherwise.
- `L402RailConfig::root_key` is a `RootKey`. `TollBoothConfig::root_key` is an `Option<RootKey>` the engine never reads, so the two need not match; leave it `None`.
- `TollBoothLayer` forwards allowed requests to the axum service it wraps. It never contacts `TollBoothConfig::upstream` (default: empty string), which is only copied into `Proxy` and `Pass` results for callers of `TollBoothEngine::handle`.
- `backend: None` is for development only. `L402Rail` always verifies `SHA256(preimage) == payment_hash` and never calls `check_invoice`; with `None` the invoice is empty and the hash is random, so nobody can authenticate.

## Public API surface

### Core types

- `TollBoothEngine` -- main engine, created from `TollBoothConfig`
- `TollBoothConfig` -- `storage: Arc<dyn StorageBackend>`, `pricing`, `upstream: String`, `root_key: Option<RootKey>` (never read by the engine), `rails: Vec<Box<dyn PaymentRail>>`, `free_tier: Option<FreeTierConfig>`, `service_name: Option<String>`
- `RootKey` -- macaroon root key; `RootKey::from_hex(&str) -> Result<RootKey, MacaroonError>` (64 hex characters); `Clone`, zeroises on drop, redacts `Debug`. Required by `L402RailConfig::root_key`
- `TollBoothResult` -- enum: `Proxy`, `Challenge`, `Pass`, `Blocked` (see below)
- `TollBoothRequest` -- method, path, headers, IP, optional tier
- `PricingEntry` -- `Simple(u64)`, `Detailed(PriceInfo)`, `Tiered(HashMap<String, u64>)`; tiered entries must have a `"default"` key or `TollBoothEngine::new` returns `TollBoothError::Config`
- `PriceInfo` -- `{ sats: Option<u64>, usd: Option<u64> }`; only `sats` is charged, `usd` is advertised in `HEAD` responses; constructors `PriceInfo::sats(n)`, `PriceInfo::usd(n)`
- `FreeTierConfig` -- `Requests(u64)` or `Credits(u64)`
- `Currency` -- `Sat` (default) or `Usd`; a separate balance bucket per payment hash, no conversion

### TollBoothResult variants

- `Proxy { upstream, headers, payment_hash, request_id, estimated_cost, credit_balance, free_remaining, tier }` -- a rail authenticated the request and the balance covered the route cost, or the free tier allowed it
- `Challenge { status: 402, headers, body }` -- no or invalid credentials and no free quota, insufficient balance, a replayed PerRequest/Session payment, a `HEAD` request (price only), or an invalid or unknown `X-Toll-Tier`
- `Pass { upstream, headers }` -- the request path is not in the pricing table
- `Blocked { status: 500, body: {"error": "payment infrastructure unavailable"} }` -- a rail's `verify` returned `Err`, or storage `debit` or `settle` failed; fails closed instead of granting free access

### Engine methods

- `TollBoothEngine::new(config: TollBoothConfig) -> Result<TollBoothEngine, TollBoothError>`
- `async fn handle(&self, req: &TollBoothRequest) -> TollBoothResult`
- `fn reconcile(&self, request_id: &str, actual_cost: u64) -> ReconcileResult` -- synchronous; `request_id` is `Proxy::request_id` (not the payment hash), one-shot; refunds `estimated - actual` via `adjust_credits` (negative debits more). `TollBoothLayer` does not forward `request_id`, so call `handle` yourself to use it

### Traits

- `PaymentRail` (`#[async_trait]`, `Send + Sync`):
  - `fn rail_type(&self) -> &str`
  - `fn credit_supported(&self) -> bool`
  - `fn detect(&self, req: &TollBoothRequest) -> bool`
  - `async fn challenge(&self, route: &str, price: &PriceInfo) -> Result<ChallengeFragment, RailError>`
  - `async fn verify(&self, req: &TollBoothRequest) -> Result<RailVerifyResult, RailError>`
  - `RailVerifyResult.mode` is a `PaymentMode`: `Credit` debits the route cost from a balance; `PerRequest` and `Session` call `StorageBackend::settle` once and challenge again on replay
- `LightningBackend` (`#[async_trait]`, `Send + Sync`):
  - `async fn create_invoice(&self, amount_sats: u64, memo: Option<&str>) -> Result<Invoice, BackendError>`
  - `async fn check_invoice(&self, payment_hash: &str) -> Result<InvoiceStatus, BackendError>`
  - optional `async fn send_payment(&self, bolt11: &str) -> Result<toll_booth::backends::PaymentResult, BackendError>`, default `Err(BackendError::NotSupported)`
  - `L402Rail` calls only `create_invoice`
- `StorageBackend` (synchronous, `Send + Sync`, all methods required): `credit()`, `debit()`, `balance()`, `adjust_credits(payment_hash, delta: i64, currency) -> Result<i64, _>`, `settle()`, `settle_with_credit(payment_hash, amount, settlement_secret: Option<&str>, currency) -> Result<bool, _>`, `is_settled()`, `get_settlement_secret()`, `store_invoice()`, `get_invoice()`, `get_invoice_for_status()`, `pending_invoice_count()`, `prune_expired_invoices()`, `prune_stale_records()`

### Custom macaroon caveats

`toll_booth::macaroon::mint_macaroon(root_key: &RootKey, payment_hash: &str, credit_balance: i64, custom_caveats: &[String], currency: Currency) -> Result<String, MacaroonError>`. Each caveat is `"key = value"`. The keys `payment_hash`, `credit_balance`, `currency`, `route`, `expires` and `ip` are reserved. `L402Rail` itself mints with no custom caveats; mint your own from a custom rail. Custom caveats reach your service as `X-Toll-Caveat-<Key>` headers.

`mint_macaroon` is the only public mint path and rejects `route`, `expires` and `ip`, so this crate cannot attach them. `verify_macaroon`, and so `L402Rail`, still enforces them on a validly signed macaroon that carries them (minted outside this crate, same V2 format and L402 identifier, same root key): `route` is an exact path or a prefix ending in `/*`, `expires` is an RFC 3339 timestamp (an unparseable value rejects), `ip` is an exact address.

### Implementations

- `L402Rail` -- L402 payment rail (macaroon + Lightning preimage verification)
- `MemoryStorage` -- in-memory storage for tests and prototypes
- `TollBoothLayer` -- Tower Layer for axum (feature: `axum-middleware`); `new(engine)`, `from_arc(Arc<TollBoothEngine>)`, `with_trusted_proxies(Vec<ipnet::IpNet>)`. The client IP is read from `ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>` (serve with `into_make_service_with_connect_info::<SocketAddr>()`); `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-Real-IP` are honoured only from trusted proxies

Not implemented yet: `SqliteStorage` and `PhoenixdBackend`. The `sqlite` and `phoenixd` features only enable the `rusqlite` and `reqwest` dependencies, and their modules are empty placeholders.

### L402 protocol flow

1. Client sends request without credentials
2. Engine returns 402 with `WWW-Authenticate: L402 macaroon="...", invoice="..."`
3. Client pays Lightning invoice, receives preimage
4. Client retries with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage_hex>`
5. Engine verifies SHA256(preimage) == payment_hash (constant-time)
6. On first use, engine settles and credits the balance
7. Subsequent requests debit from balance until exhausted
8. Engine issues fresh 402 when balance runs out

## Feature flags

| Feature           | Default | What it enables                          |
|-------------------|---------|------------------------------------------|
| `l402`            | yes     | L402 payment rail                        |
| `axum-middleware` | yes     | Tower Layer for axum                     |
| `sqlite`          | yes     | Reserved (enables `rusqlite`); `SqliteStorage` not yet implemented |
| `phoenixd`        | no      | Reserved (enables `reqwest`); `PhoenixdBackend` not yet implemented |
